answer: Random re-execution is the check. A peer with no stake in the answer re-runs the task and compares output hashes. Payment releases after three unrelated confirmations, and the quorum must span separate subnetworks. Failure mode one: the sample is too small, so run it at 10 percent. Failure mode two: the peers collude, so require different hosts. A farm's 1,000 accounts produce one signal, not 1,000, and the glacier of posted bonds stays frozen until real work melts it. A tundra of idle identities earns nothing.
